article.content: Alexia Putellas picks up women’s award for third time England captain acclaimed in London ceremony Harry Kane is the Ballon d’Or winner for 2026, the first Englishman to win football’s most prestigious individual trophy in 25 years. Two hours into a lavishly excitable ceremony at the Palladium Theatre in London, Kane’s name emerged from the final envelope to wild cheers inside the auditorium. The women’s Ballon d’Or, awarded moments earlier, was won by Alexia Putellas of London City Lionesses, a third Ballon, five years on from her first in the colours of Barcelona. Continue reading...

Football history has been rewritten in the British capital as **Harry Kane** claimed the **2026** men’s Ballon d'Or, ending a quarter-century drought for English players. According to Sport | The Guardian, the England captain received football's most coveted individual prize during a lavish ceremony in **London** on **October 26, 2026**. This milestone victory makes him the first Englishman to lift the trophy in **25 years**.

## A Historic Night for International Football

The gala evening also highlighted excellence in the women's game, where **Alexia Putellas** secured the women's award for the third time, as reported by Sport | The Guardian. While the publication noted the grand scale of the event, the focus remained firmly on the English striker's achievement. Fans and analysts alike have dissected how the forward managed this feat; for a deeper dive into his recent performances, readers can review our breakdown of [Kane ends England's 25-year Ballon d'Or wait - how he bucked the trend](https://new-sfeed.lovable.app/en/articles/kane-ends-england-s-year-ballon-d-or-wait-how-he-bucked).

## The Path to the Prize

The Ballon d'Or, established in **1956** by France Football magazine, has historically favored players competing in continental European leagues, making English winners a rarity. To understand the sheer volume of skill that propelled him to this global recognition, supporters often look back at his domestic dominance. You can explore a curated selection of his standout strikes by checking out [Ballon d'Or winner? Kane's best Bundesliga goals](https://new-sfeed.lovable.app/en/articles/kane-prematurely-announced-as-ballon-d-or-winner-but-he-wasn-t) on our platform. 

## Context: Why This Milestone Matters

*(Context: This victory represents a major psychological shift for English football, which has long produced elite talent but struggled to capture individual global accolades due to fierce competition from Spanish and Italian leagues. For the player, this validates years of prolific goalscoring across both club and international fixtures, cementing his legacy alongside past British greats who managed to conquer Europe's voting panels.)*

*(Context: Observers will be watching closely to see how this prestigious accolade influences upcoming international fixtures and whether club commitments will see increased scrutiny as opposing defenses adapt to the newly crowned global player of the year.)*
